problem_diagnosis.core_bottleneck: Unsynchronized batch processing and legacy mechanical interlocks creating throughput starvation.
root_causes: Fixed cycle time variance exceeding tolerance thresholds (+/- 18%).
Sub-optimal material buffering between staging and assembly.
Lack of closed-loop telemetry and dynamic load balancing.

approved_solution.name: Modular Micro-Cell Architecture with Predictive Edge Orchestration (MM-PEO)
approved_solution.value_proposition: Decouples monolithic throughput dependencies into self-balancing autonomous cells, delivering +24.5% net output with 8.4-month capital payback.

red_team_defense.question: What happens if vendor lead times for the micro-cell modules slip by 8 weeks?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: Dual-sourcing agreements are established for all critical mechanical actuators. Horizon 1 deploys software telemetry onto existing machinery first, unlocking +10% gain before physical hardware arrives.

red_team_defense.question: How do you defend the 68.5% gross margin when industry median sits at 54%?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: Our model incorporates modular field-replaceable units (FRUs) which reduce on-site engineering labor hours by 42% compared to bespoke installations.

red_team_defense.question: What is the primary risk of catastrophic failure during Horizon 2 rollout?
red_team_defense.rebuttal: Line integration collision. Mitigated by digital twin hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation preceding each physical cell commissioning.
